scenario.name: GitHub Trending Daily Brief
scenario.description: Checks GitHub Trending each morning and sends one email per newly-trending repository that gained 50+ stars that day. Agent memory ensures each repo is only reported once (it won't re-appear on subsequent days unless it re-enters the trending list after the 2-day TTL expires). Adjust the language filter, star threshold, and recipient address to taste.

agents.name: Fetch GitHub Trending
agents.description: Scrapes https://github.com/trending each morning for newly-trending repositories. Leave language blank to monitor all languages, or set it to a slug like 'python', 'typescript', 'rust'. Runs daily at 08:00.

agents.name: Filter High-Momentum Repos
agents.description: Keeps only repositories that gained 50 or more stars today, discarding low-activity entries. Raise or lower this threshold to adjust sensitivity.

agents.name: Format Notification
agents.description: Builds a subject line and plain-text email body from the repository metadata.

templates.subject: Trending on GitHub: {{ name }}{% if language %} ({{ language }}){% endif %} — {{ stars_today }} stars today

agents.name: Send Email
agents.description: Sends one email per qualifying repository. Change to_email to your address before enabling.
